The official gesture model card does not state a separate explicit weights license. Do not infer model licensing from the documentation page's CC-BY footer.

localBaselineComparison.method: SHA-256 of decompressed embedded TFLite files; no inference performed

handDetector.note: Different file hashes do not alone establish different numerical model weights or behavior. Full baseline equivalence is not established.

integration: Opt-in diagnostic learned recognition. One GestureRecognizer graph supplies landmarks and learned categories per delegate; default remains HandLandmarker. Categories including None are forwarded without allowlist filtering.
